body:
**Tier:** T3 (release gate: a new EAS build hook can fail every release build)
**Why:** Lane S-RELEASE-MOB item 3. A clinic release build must not ship when a required `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` value is missing or a placeholder. `--release-env` already existed (S-ENVTRUTH) but was not wired into any build, checked only non-empty, and knew nothing about build profiles.
**T4 trigger scan:** none. No `.github/workflows/*`, `scripts/ci/*` or branch-protection file is touched. CI still runs `node scripts/check-expected-env.js` unchanged; the source-scan mode behaves as before. No auth, payment, PII or migration change. Values are never printed.
**T3 trigger scan:** yes. New `eas-build-pre-install` npm hook (package.json **scripts only**, no dependency change), and new rules that can stop a release build.
**Bounded T1:** `docs/RELEASE_ENV_CHECK.md`.
**Builder-owner:** Claude Opus 5.5 (S-RELEASE-MOB, agent 112). Owner: operator. Needs an independent audit plus green CI.
**Acceptance evidence:** `releaseEnvProfile.test.js` (new) + `expectedEnv.test.js` + `validateAppConfig.test.js`: 99/99 locally. `node scripts/check-expected-env.js` OK. CI runs tsc and the full suites.
**Promotion triggers:** adding a bypass flag; changing `releaseProfiles` requirements; moving the hook to a workflow file.

## What it checks (`node scripts/check-expected-env.js --list --profile clinic`)
| Profile | Values that must be set and real | Stripe |
|---|---|---|
| **clinic** | `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` | `pk_live_` |
| production | same five | `pk_live_` |
| preview | the four `kind: "required"` names | `pk_live_` or `pk_test_` |
| development | skipped | — |

Each value is rejected when:
- **Placeholder:** empty, `your_…_here`, `REPLACE_WITH_*`, `<…>`, `${…}`, `changeme` / `todo` / `xxx`, or a copied masked `*****`.
- **URL** (`API_URL`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `HELP_BASE_URL`): not `https`, or the host is localhost, an emulator or private IP, `example.*`, or `*.invalid` / `*.test` / `*.local`.
- **Supabase anon key:** not a JWT with role `anon` and not an `sb_publishable_` key. A **service_role JWT** or an **`sb_secret_`** key fails, because either would ship an RLS bypass in the bundle.
- **Sentry DSN:** not of the form `https://<key>@<host>/<id>`.
- **Stripe key:** a test key on a store profile.

**Build parity:** for clinic, every resolved `eas.json` `build.clinic.env` value must reach the build unchanged:
- the 7 clinic `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_*` / mock flags
- `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_IOS_HIDE_NON_P2P_PURCHASES`
- `EXPO_PUBLIC_NOTIFICATIONS_MOCK`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_MOCK_COMMAND_CENTER`
- `TGP_ANDROID_HEALTH_CONNECT`

The existing secret-shaped-name check stays.

## How it runs
- **EAS:** `"eas-build-pre-install": "node scripts/check-expected-env.js --eas-hook"`.
  - It runs before `npm install`, so it fails fast and saves build minutes on the Free plan. It needs only Node built-ins: no TypeScript, so the source scan is left to CI.
  - The profile comes from `EAS_BUILD_PROFILE`. A non-release profile is skipped. An unset profile fails closed.
- **Operator, before queueing a build:** `eas env:exec production 'npm run check:release-env -- --profile clinic'`.
- `scripts/eas-profile.js` resolves `extends` the way EAS does. It is byte-identical to the copy in mobile #305, so the two PRs add the same file and merge without conflict in either order.

## Tests
```
heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand scripts/__tests__/releaseEnvProfile.test.js scripts/__tests__/expectedEnv.test.js scripts/__tests__/validateAppConfig.test.js  -> 3 suites, 99 passed
node scripts/check-expected-env.js -> OK (57 names)
EAS_BUILD_PROFILE=development node scripts/check-expected-env.js --eas-hook -> skipped, exit 0
EAS_BUILD_PROFILE=clinic node scripts/check-expected-env.js --eas-hook (no values) -> 5 problems, exit 1
```
The new suite covers:
- every placeholder and format rule, including service_role and sb_secret_ keys
- real-looking values passing
- Stripe live vs test per profile
- a clinic flag overridden in the build environment
- CLI output never containing the value
- the hook's skip and fail-closed paths
- the package.json hook wiring
- the clinic list exactly as above

## Before merging (operator)
Once merged, every `preview`, `production` and `clinic` EAS build runs this gate. Run `eas env:exec production 'npm run check:release-env -- --profile clinic'` and `eas env:exec preview 'npm run check:release-env -- --profile preview'` first. If the production environment has no `EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN`, or still holds a Stripe test key, the clinic build fails with the exact fix. Both requirements are by design (owner error-reporting rule; real clients pay). Flagged for operator confirmation.

## Fix rounds
| Round | Head | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | abfc5d1 | — (initial; CI green) | — |
title: feat(release): pre-build release-env check per EAS profile (clinic, production, preview)
